findings.claim: 10-K 列名半導體測試對手為 Advantest、SPEA、Cohu，並指出面臨新興亞洲公司與客戶內部自製供應的競爭
findings.excerpt: Competitors in the Semiconductor Test segment include, among others, Advantest Corporation, SPEA S.p.A., and Cohu, Inc.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：面臨新興亞洲公司及數家客戶內部開發的競爭，且美國貿易法規未必約束部分對手
findings.excerpt: We also face competition from emerging Asian companies and internal development at several of our customers.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱貿易限制使其在部分市場競爭力受限，因部分對手不受同樣限制
findings.excerpt: current trade restrictions are limiting our ability to be competitive, particularly in certain markets, where some competitors are not subjected to the same restrictions.

findings.claim: Futurum：Q2 FY2026 Teradyne 出貨首筆 merchant GPU 訂單，並在第二家超大型雲端客戶完成 correlation，為 2027 年份額提升鋪路
findings.source: Futurum Group, Teradyne Q2 FY 2026 Doubles Semiconductor Test Revenue
findings.excerpt: Teradyne shipped its first merchant GPU order and completed correlation at a second hyperscaler, steps that widen its compute customer base and set up share gains in 2027.

findings.claim: Seeking Alpha：Advantest 與 Teradyne 雙寡占份額消長，稱 Advantest 2025 年取得顯著份額
findings.source: Seeking Alpha, Advantest/Teradyne: Market Share Shifts In This Duopoly
